name: Simplenote
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Simplenote integrates electron-updater: it checks and retrieves updates, reports progress, and calls the install action after user confirmation. The project also declares electron-builder and macOS notarization tooling; the checked application source does not independently establish SHA512 enforcement or signing of Linux release artifacts.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot at the recorded commit, not historical release re-verification; electron-updater internals, generated update manifests, and released artifact signatures were not audited.

original_evidence.text: | Simplenote | https://github.com/Automattic/simplenote-electron | Electron (electron-updater 6.3.9) | Y | mac/win/AppImage: chk+dl automatic in background, install on user confirm ("Update & Restart" dialog); Linux deb/rpm/tar.gz: notify-only manual (opens browser to GitHub Releases page, no in-app download) | Y on mac/win/AppImage (electron-updater's `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()` runs the downloaded installer); N on other Linux package formats (external browser only) | https — electron-updater's default GitHub provider (derived from `package.json` `repository` field, no explicit `publish` block in `electron-builder.json`) fetching `latest.yml`/release assets from github.com; Linux manual-updater path also calls `api.github.com/repos/automattic/simplenote-electron/releases/latest` and the `latest.yml` asset directly. No TLS-verification bypass found anywhere in the repo — TLS enforced. | N — `latest.yml` (electron-updater's update manifest) is a plain, unsigned YAML file; no GPG/signature on the manifest itself | hash-from-manifest (electron-updater validates the `sha512` field embedded in `latest.yml` against the downloaded installer) + OS-code-signing as an additional layer on mac/win (mac: `hardenedRuntime`+entitlements+notarization via `after_sign_hook.js`; win: NSIS installer signed, `publisherName` set to "Automattic, Inc.") — this signing/verification logic lives inside the `electron-updater` dependency itself, not in this app repo, so is asserted per electron-updater's documented default behavior rather than independently re-verified here | sha512 hash sourced from the unsigned `latest.yml` published alongside the GitHub release (not a public-key signature); code-signing certs are Automattic's Apple Developer ID / Authenticode certs, checked by the OS at install time | `desktop/updater/auto-updater/index.js:6` (`const { autoUpdater } = require('electron-updater')`), `:30` (`autoUpdater.checkForUpdates()`), `:42` (`autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()`); `desktop/updater/manual-updater/index.js:38-71` (fetch GitHub API → fetch `latest.yml` asset → `yaml.load` → `semver.lt` compare), `:88-90` (`onConfirm(){ shell.openExternal(this.downloadUrl) }`); `desktop/config-updater.json:3-5` (`downloadUrl`/`changelogUrl`/`apiUrl` all `github.com`/`api.github.com`); `package.json:23-26` (`repository.url` = `git://github.com/Automattic/simplenote-electron.git`), `package.json:130` (`"electron-updater": "6.3.9"`); `desktop/updater/index.js:13-28` (platform branch: mac/win/APPIMAGE → AutoUpdater, else → ManualUpdater) |

fields.label: auto
fields.value: mac/win/AppImage: chk+dl automatic in background, install on user confirm ("Update & Restart" dialog); Linux deb/rpm/tar.gz: notify-only manual (opens browser to GitHub Releases page, no in-app download)

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: Y on mac/win/AppImage (electron-updater's `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()` runs the downloaded installer); N on other Linux package formats (external browser only)

fields.label: transport
fields.value: https — electron-updater's default GitHub provider (derived from `package.json` `repository` field, no explicit `publish` block in `electron-builder.json`) fetching `latest.yml`/release assets from github.com; Linux manual-updater path also calls `api.github.com/repos/automattic/simplenote-electron/releases/latest` and the `latest.yml` asset directly. No TLS-verification bypass found anywhere in the repo — TLS enforced.

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N — `latest.yml` (electron-updater's update manifest) is a plain, unsigned YAML file; no GPG/signature on the manifest itself

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: hash-from-manifest (electron-updater validates the `sha512` field embedded in `latest.yml` against the downloaded installer) + OS-code-signing as an additional layer on mac/win (mac: `hardenedRuntime`+entitlements+notarization via `after_sign_hook.js`; win: NSIS installer signed, `publisherName` set to "Automattic, Inc.") — this signing/verification logic lives inside the `electron-updater` dependency itself, not in this app repo, so is asserted per electron-updater's documented default behavior rather than independently re-verified here

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: sha512 hash sourced from the unsigned `latest.yml` published alongside the GitHub release (not a public-key signature); code-signing certs are Automattic's Apple Developer ID / Authenticode certs, checked by the OS at install time
